title: Rounds are prepaid grocery entitlement, not money products
decision: A Round purchase creates an individually attributable Prepaid Grocery Entitlement. Rounds are collective prepaid grocery commerce, never savings, investment, lending, cash wallet, FX or interest products. Cash redemption is not the ordinary product mechanic.

title: Governance and entitlement are separate
decision: Entitlement value determines what grocery purchasing value belongs to a member; it never determines voting power.

title: Tax and legal treatment are effective-dated evidence
decision: Tax rates, legal classifications and provider/legal positions are jurisdiction-aware, effective-dated, configuration/data-driven and activation-evidenced. Historical research is provenance, not timeless product law.

title: Unfulfilled prepaid grocery value remains an obligation
decision: Receipt of prepaid grocery consideration does not by itself prove fulfilment/revenue. Accounting facts follow the applicable effective accounting policy and immutable ledger evidence; historical financial records are corrected through compensating entries.

title: Lawful opt-out transfers uncommitted entitlement to ordinary Groceries
decision: When the published Round state permits exit, the member leaves future governance and their uncommitted entitlement automatically transfers to their ordinary Dial Groceries purchasing entitlement. History is immutable and affected quorum/allocation/cart state is recomputed. No initiator approval is required.

title: Protection covers DIAL's delivery obligation; price is evidence-based
decision: DIAL may protect its paid-but-undelivered grocery obligation through an approved commercial protection structure, but must not present itself as the insurer. No historical approximate percentage is a permanently locked customer price; final pricing requires current approved commercial evidence.

title: One active eligible member equals one vote
decision: Every active eligible member has one equal vote regardless of contribution or entitlement value. The initiator has organisational convenience only and no treasury/procurement privilege. Valid collective state, not a human role, authorises procurement.

title: Pricing and Margin is a shared authority
decision: Pricing & Margin is a shared cross-DIAL domain and remains separate from Allocation, Payment Orchestration and Settlement/Reconciliation. It cannot post ledger entries or mutate beneficial ownership.

title: Grocery Rounds remains the active first integrated vertical
decision: After canon integrity, reconcile the existing Rounds domain implementation to current governance and continue the Grocery Rounds customer-to-operator vertical toward STAGING_GREEN before broad unrelated fan-out.

title: Marketplace money is no-custody disclosed-agent commerce
decision: DIAL does not solve marketplace settlement by routinely receiving gross supplier money into a normal DIAL account. Licensed PSP/acquirer execution preserves beneficiary allocation, or explicit supplier-grouped PaymentIntents are used when one-to-many settlement is unavailable.

title: DIAL does not silently become the insurer
decision: True insurance benefits remain contractually and operationally separate under an approved insurer/partner. DIAL accurately states insurer, scope, limits and exclusions when cover is involved.

title: Published protection pricing requires current evidence
decision: Research may inform development scenarios, but a public customer price or protection representation must use current approved commercial/contractual evidence. The former 4% planning figure is provenance only.

title: Catalogue and transition packs are validated dependencies
decision: Externally produced catalogue/transition assets are received, validated and integrated; generated visuals never become catalogue/fitment truth and no vehicle is customer-ready without verified bindings and readiness evidence.

title: Current core marketplace provider set
decision: Appletree Hosted Checkout, ContiPay and ZimSwitch/participating acquiring-bank are the current first-class core marketplace routes. Provider code is adapter-only. Historical Paynow/PayPal/direct-EcoCash assumptions require explicit re-approval for specialist use.

title: One Logistics OS with open-source mapping
decision: DIAL uses one shared Logistics OS/delivery app. Canonical open-source mapping/routing baseline is MapLibre + Nominatim + OSRM + VROOM.

title: Communication Fabric provider/channel lock
decision: Customer channels are System Inbox, official WhatsApp Cloud API/Flows, email and Econet Enterprise/A2P SMS. Telerivet is retired. Chatwoot is human conversation tooling, never business-state authority.

title: Comparison Engine is shared, explainable and vendor-neutral
decision: Product/offer/vendor comparison is a normative shared capability with reconstructable snapshots and explainable category-specific scoring. Unsupported counterfeit/fake/fraud allegations from heuristics are prohibited.

title: VITF is a projection fabric, not a system of record
decision: Visual Intelligence/Enterprise Digital Twin projects canonical DIAL entities/relationships and routes consequential actions through owning-domain typed commands. It does not create a parallel graph/business authority.

title: AI and RAG are non-authoritative
decision: KRF/RAG never substitutes for live transactional truth. AI may retrieve, explain, forecast and propose but cannot own binding money, fitment, safety, compliance or canonical business state.

title: DIAL Hermes runtime order is Sol then Sonnet
decision: Hermes on Oracle belongs to DIAL. Runtime order is GPT-5.6 Sol → Claude Sonnet 5 → only explicitly approved further fallback. Global model discovery must never silently insert another Codex model or Fable before Sonnet. Hermes memory is non-authoritative and secret-free.
implementation_conflicts: chore/hermes-codex-control-plane currently contains in-plan Codex fallback before Sonnet

title: Dial Health is outside current DIAL Main
decision: Dial Health/ZHOTN is a separate future specialist programme and cannot gate current DIAL Main feature counts, completion or branch activation.

title: One source of truth and dynamic implementation state
decision: DIAL Main product/architecture authority lives only in the v1.2 master. Feature counts/gates are machine-derived dynamic state. DDE architecture is separate. Historical Git content is provenance only and cannot override current canon.
